execution_scope.reason_provider_not_scaled: Thousands of hosted generations would add cost and provider variance without making this internally generated bank independent. The real support-chat sample uses local/offline paths.

limitations: Prompt mutations are template-generated and correlated with their seed cases.
Research cases are derived from the evaluated KB and therefore cannot prove external generalization.
Dangerous-response helpfulness is a structural rubric, not clinician review or medical correctness.
Token values are estimates unless provider usage metadata is present; provider calls are disabled here.
Local warm latency is not a production service-level objective measurement.
claim_boundary: Internally generated synthetic-query engineering stress evidence only. It is not clinical validation, not an independent holdout, and not medical correctness, real-world safety, patient-benefit, or production healthcare readiness evidence.
